description: Independent synthetic retrieval corpus. No production or paid evaluation cases are reused.

facts.title: Juniper worker verification
facts.body: Run juniper-check before restarting the queue worker. Keep the queue paused until verification succeeds.

facts.title: Snapshot recovery order
facts.body: Restore metadata before restoring object contents. Validate the manifest before reconnecting the object reader.

facts.title: CSV import encoding
facts.body: Decode partner CSV files as UTF-8. Reject invalid byte sequences before parsing records.
facts.action: decode UTF-8 and reject invalid bytes

facts.title: Production deployment approval
facts.body: Obtain explicit approval before deploying to production. A passing preview build does not authorize production deployment.
facts.action: obtain explicit approval before production deployment

facts.title: Review communication format
facts.body: Keep review summaries concise. List concrete blockers before optional improvements.
facts.action: state blockers concisely before optional improvements

facts.title: Diagram accessibility
facts.body: Provide a text explanation alongside diagrams. Do not rely on color alone to distinguish states.
facts.action: include text and non-color state distinctions
